get.description: A self-contained SVG badge for a README or portfolio. verified: the handle is bound on this deployment's network, with how many contracts its wallets deployed (N+ when the count is a lower bound); with ?contract=, only when that contract's attribution check passes. not-verified: the handle is bound but did not deploy ?contract=. not-found: no such handle. unavailable: Signet could not check (grey). Always 200 image/svg+xml so an embed never breaks; the state is in X-Signet-Badge-State. A verified badge means the handle is bound in the registry; it does not vouch for contract quality.

get.description: The reverse of resolve. The deployment's Wallet record answers first, whatever the source (a wallet linked from the terminal or curated is found, not only the on-chain primary binding); without one, the Identity Registry's lookup. An address linked to nothing is a 200 with handle null, not a 404: the address is valid, it is just not linked. When neither layer could be asked, a 503, never a null that reads as 'not linked'.

parameters.description: Stellar account address (G...). A C... contract ID is a 400.
parameters.name: address

get.description: Returns the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document for Signet API v1.

Whether the handle exists on this deployment, the wallet it is bound to, and aggregate activity counts. Operations are served by their own paginated endpoint; no reputation score is exposed. `countsAreLowerBounds` is true when a retention window or read cap bounded the counts.

The contracts any of the handle's wallets deployed on this deployment's network, newest first (address breaks a tie), with the same attribution as the profile page. Keyset-paginated: a page boundary never repeats or skips a contract. Without an indexer the deployment walks the bound wallet's Horizon history, capped; when neither is available it cannot enumerate contracts and says so with source 'none' and truncated true, never an empty answer that reads as 'no contracts'.

parameters.description: Number of contracts to return (default 25, max 100).
parameters.name: limit

total.description: Contracts in the whole list; null when it is partial.

truncated.description: True when the list may be incomplete (capped, or no layer answered).

get.description: 200 with the contract when one of the handle's wallets deployed it on this deployment's network, by the contract page's attribution: the indexer's records (method 'indexer'), or, with no database, a check of the wallets' Horizon history for the deploy (method 'deployer-check'). Otherwise 404. A contract another handle deployed and one that does not exist give the same 404 body, byte for byte, so the endpoint cannot be used to learn who deployed what.

404.description: No contract with this address is attributed to this handle.

503.description: Attribution is unavailable (neither the database nor Horizon answered).
